FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FireBolt:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1d3 burn effects: the target takes 1 damage per turn per effect for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fireball:
Unplayable if no target in the zone carries 3 burn effects.
Discard 3 cards.
Place a circular area with a 2-tile radius.
Deals {0_damage} damage to every covered target.
Applies 4 burn effects to each of them: 4 damage per turn for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.StoneColossus:
Sacrifice 3 hit points per X.
Deals {0_damage} raw damage.
Applies 2 earth effects with no roll: -2 dodge for 4 turns.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DamageGust:
Discard X cards: the die becomes 1d(1+X).
Deals {0_damage} damage.
The result is the number of air effects applied (-1 tile of movement each, 2 turns).
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.AbsoluteZero:
Spend X zeal points and X mana points: the spell hits X targets.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
Applies 2 frost effects to each target with no roll: -2 max action points for 3 turns.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Tornado:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1d2 air effects: each reduces the target's movement by 1 tile for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Frostfire:
Requires 1 burn or freeze effect.
Deals {0_damage} damage and applies 2 burn effects (2 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FrostStrike:
Deals {0_damage} damage.
1 chance in 2 to freeze the target, increasing the cost of their spells by 1 action point for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.EarthFracture:
Deals {0_damage} damage (Xmax = {0_xmax}).
1d(4-X) chance to apply an earth effect that reduces the target's dodge by 1 for 4 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VoidAssassin: Requires 2 different elemental effects. +1 to critical chance for this attack for each effect applied to the target. Deals {0_damage} damage (Xmax = {0_xmax}, Ymax = {0_ymax}).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaCapture: When you take damage, recover {0_mana} mana points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Incantation:
Defer X action points to the next turn.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MagicPlastron:
Requires 1 active earth or ice effect on the target.
Remove the effect, and you gain {0_heal} temporary hit points for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IceWave:
Requires 1 active air or ice effect on at least one target.
Deals {0_damage} damage to all adjacent targets.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Fog:
Requires 1 active air or earth effect on at least one target.
All enemy targets lose @wis in critical chance and @int in dodge for 3 turns. 1 in 4 chance to blind them for 1 turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FireShock:
Requires 1 active air or fire effect on one of the two targets.
Deals {0_damage} damage to up to 2 enemies and applies 3 burn effects to them (3 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Meteor:
Requires 1 active earth or fire effect on one of the targets.
Place a 3x3-tile area.
Deals {0_damage} damage to covered targets and applies 2 burn effects to them (2 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DamagePropagation: Each time you play a card that affects a single target, choose another target within range. It takes @wis damage per turn for 3 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Charge:
Charge an enemy within 9 squares.
For 1 turn, increase damage by @dex, plus 1d4, and critical chance by @str.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HeroicStrike:
Deal {0_damage} damage.
You may choose not to spend your mana point and instead lose 6 hit points, minus @con.
2 extra damage if the target is already bleeding.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ManaSurge:
Regain twice the amount of mana points spent on your last spell.
(Costs 1 less action point per @wis)
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ShieldBash:
Requires an equipped shield.
If you take damage from a target within 6 squares, you leap to an adjacent square next to it (the closest to you) and deal {0_damage} damage to it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Hemorrhage:
Deal {0_damage} damage and make the target bleed, dealing an additional @str damage per turn for 2 turns.
You may choose not to spend your mana point and instead lose 6 hit points, minus @con.

FQCARDENGINE.CardMsgSynapseFrost: The target's reflexes seize: {action} fewer maximum action point(s) and {range} less range for 2 turns
FQCARDENGINE.CardMsgBreathRetreat: You break away: {movement} movement and {evasion} dodge for 1 turn
FQCARDENGINE.CardMsgResidualHeat: You siphon the target's residual heat and recover 2 mana points
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Calcination:
Requires an active burn effect AND an active earth effect on the same target.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
The stone is consumed: the target's earth effects vanish and leave 4 burn effects (4 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.GlowingCloud:
Requires an active burn effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
Choose X between 1 and 2.
Every enemy in the combat receives X burn effects (X damage per turn for 3 turns) and X air effects.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ExtremeFusion:
Requires an active burn effect AND an active freeze effect on the same target.
Both elements cancel out in a detonation that deafens the target for 2 turns: all the target's burn and freeze effects vanish.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.RubbleWind:
Requires an active earth effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
Strike up to 3 targets.
Deals {0_damage} damage to each: the gust grows heavier with every added target.
Applies 1 air effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Permafrost:
Requires an active earth effect AND an active freeze effect on the same target.
Deals {0_damage} damage: the frozen ground bites harder for every freeze effect the target carries.
Applies 1 earth effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SynapseFrost:
Requires an active freeze effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
The cold reaches its reflexes: incapacitated, it loses @int maximum action points and @wis range for 2 turns.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.CurrentReading:
Requires an active freeze, earth or air effect on the target.
You read the currents running through it and draw 1 card.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.StokeEmbers:
Requires an active burn, earth or air effect on the target.
You breathe on what smoulders: applies 2 burn effects (2 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BreathRetreat:
Requires an active burn, freeze or air effect on the target.
You lean on its element to break away: you gain @wis movement and @int dodge for 1 turn.
FQCARDENGINE.CardMsgWhiteNecrosis: The necrosis sets in: the target can no longer regain hit points until the end of the combat
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VolcanoHeart:
Requires an active burn effect AND an active earth effect on the same target.
You split the rock beneath its feet at the cost of 5 hit points.
The blow ALWAYS crits: it deals {0_damage} damage, doubled.
Applies 3 burn effects (3 damage per turn for 3 turns).
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.WhirlingBlaze:
Requires an active burn effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
The blaze settles in and fans itself at the start of each of your turns, paying its cost again.
Each turn, every enemy in the combat takes {0_damage} damage and receives 1 burn effect (1 damage per turn for 3 turns).
It skips its turn if no enemy carries both elements any more, and goes to the discard as soon as you can no longer pay.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.TelluricConvergence:
Requires an active earth effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
Place a 2-tile radius circle.
Every element sown across the battlefield converges: deals {0_damage} damage to covered targets, more for every elemental effect the enemy side carries.
Applies to each 1 earth effect and 1 air effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IceWall:
Place a 4-square line.
A wall of ice rises: impassable, it also blocks sight until the GM dispels it.
Deals {0_damage} damage to covered targets.
Applies 1 freeze effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.WhiteNecrosis:
Requires an active freeze effect AND an active air effect on the same target.
Deals {0_damage} damage.
The frozen flesh no longer knits: the target can no longer regain hit points until the end of the combat.
Applies 1 freeze effect.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HealingWake:
Move up to 7 spaces, plus @dex, in one direction (without obstacles). All allies you pass through recover {0_heal} hit points.
You recover {0_hp} hit points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.JadePalm:
Restores {0_heal} hit points to the target, and you recover {0_hp} hit points.
X max = {0_xmax}
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Hyperactivity: Gain as many action points as cards remaining in your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.MartialMomentum: Gain as many zeal points as cards already played this round.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.PerpetualBreath: Focus your breath: the spell settles into your hand and grants you 1 zeal point at the start of each of your turns, at no further cost.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ZealSurge: Automatic: gain 1 zeal point, once per turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BreathReading: Three cards from your deck are offered: add one of them to your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SecondWind: At the start of your next turn, you draw 2 extra cards.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HundredFormsFists: Deals {0_damage} damage, X being the number of cards remaining in your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.FullSerenity:
Restores {0_hp} hit points and increases your evasion by X until your next turn.
X being the number of cards remaining in your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ReedStance:
You permanently gain 1 evasion point and 1 zeal point.
In exchange, all your damage is reduced by 1 for 1 turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.ThousandLeavesPalm: Deals {0_damage} damage to every adjacent target, X being the number of cards remaining in your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.InnerFervor: Gain as many zeal points as half of remaining cards in your hand.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Cadence: Deals {0_damage} damage, X being the number of cards already played this round.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BreathCycle: Draw as many cards as you have already played this round.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Emptiness:
Discard X cards.
Gain X action points and X zeal points.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.IronGauntlet: Increases all your damage by 1 until the end of the combat.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HealingRing:
Restores {0_heal} hit points to a target within 1 space (including yourself).
X is the number of action points you have spent this turn
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.VoidStep:
2 charges.
Teleport @dex spaces straight ahead, in the direction of the target, which must be aligned in front of you
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.HealingTransfer:
Transfers X of your hit points to an adjacent target.
You gain 1 zeal point.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.Hook:
Deals {0_damage} damage and grants you 1d2 zeal points.
You may play this card again if you have already spent 4 action points this turn.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.DawnPalm:
You lay your palm and let through everything you have left: spend X action points and restore X hit points to a target in contact.
No cap: the whole turn's budget can go into it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.SecretRemedies:
Reactive: discard X cards and restore {0_heal} hit points to a target within 6 tiles, yourself included.
No cap: your whole hand can go into it.
FQCARDDESCRIPTION.BlueBlood:
Sacrifice 2X hit points to gain X mana points.
Xmax = {0_xmax}
